name: Aegis Draw
description: Draw one aegis of soul about the mind and set it facing the nearest hostile will.

name: Aegis Tilt
description: Tilt the aegis to meet a blow edge-on so that its force skates off.

name: Aegis Mend
description: Smooth the dents of a battered aegis with slow attention until it rings clear again.

name: Dual Gauge
description: Gauge a hostile soul against both aegis at once to learn its rung and its favoured angle.

name: Step Together
description: Move both aegis one pace in unison so that the guard keeps its shape as it shifts.

name: Aegis Chime
description: Ring the two aegis against one another to cancel the hum of an incoming soul strike.

name: Paired Closure
description: Close the two aegis about the user like a pair of hands and hold against a siege of will.

name: Dual Reprisal
description: Face the aegis outward as a pair and send a hostile strike back in two halves.

name: Twin Sovereign
description: Raise the two aegis together over many breaths until they drink in a whole barrage of soul force.

name: Half Shield
description: Hold half of the mind-shield forward and keep the other half in reserve behind it.

name: Half Turn
description: Turn the forward half of the shield so that a blow slides onto the reserve half.

name: Seam Listen
description: Watch the seam where the two halves meet and read any hostile soul that tests it.

name: Seam Heal
description: Draw the seam shut with a slow pull and ease the soul behind it.

name: Reserve Swing
description: Swing the reserve half forward the moment the first half cracks.

name: Latch Bind
description: Latch the two halves about a hostile soul touch and hold it fast for a moment.

name: Half Lend
description: Lend the reserve half to an ally so that their mind stands guarded as well.

name: Clasp Reverse
description: Clasp a hostile lash between the halves and turn it on the one who sent it.

name: Whole Hold
description: Join both halves into one shield and bear an assault that lasts many breaths.

name: Shut Maw
description: Open the halves wide to swallow a hostile soul strike and snap them shut around it.

name: Lifted Mantle
description: Lift the mantle high above the head so that it covers the soul from all sides.

name: Level Match
description: Match the height of the mantle to the height of a strike and turn it neatly.

name: Overlook
description: Look down on the whole field of minds from above the mantle and mark each rising threat.

name: Dawn Wash
description: Wash the mind in clear morning calm until the weariness of a long contest drains away.

name: Feather Shed
description: Shed a hostile soul touch from the mantle as a hawk sheds rain from its feathers.

name: Updraft Lift
description: Lift an ally's flagging spirit on a rising current of steady will.

name: Stooping Cover
description: Drop the whole mantle from above onto an ally the instant a soul blow is aimed at them.

name: Feather Sweep
description: Sweep the mantle's wings across a field of hostile will and scatter its force.

name: Azure Dominion
description: Spread the mantle over the sky of the mind and drink in every hostile pull while allies rise under it.

name: Bowl Ward
description: Hollow the ward like a basin so that a hostile force pours into it and settles.

name: Spill Away
description: Tip the basin so that the gathered force of a strike spills harmlessly to the side.

name: Reserve Plumb
description: Sound how much hostile force the basin holds and how much room remains.

name: Settling Rest
description: Let the basin settle until the clouded waters of a troubled mind are clear.

name: Slow Drain
description: Let the held force drain down through the soul and out into the ground.

name: Silt Lift
description: Let the taint of a hostile touch settle as silt and then lift it clean out of an ally.

name: Banked Calm
description: Bank a store of calm in the basin and pour a measure of it into an ally.

name: Full Bowl
description: Hold the full basin against a flood of hostile will without letting a drop spill.

name: Sluice Release
description: Open the sluice of the basin and loose the stored force back at the sender in one rush.

name: Deluge Bowl
description: Gather an entire storm of soul force into the basin and return it as a single great deluge.

name: Current Ward
description: Set the ward flowing like a current so that a push cannot find a still place to hold.

name: Carry Off
description: Let the current take a hostile strike and carry it downstream and out of reach.

name: Ripple Read
description: Read the ripples on the current to learn the shape of a soul that touches it.

name: Eddy Turn
description: Spin an eddy in the current to draw a hostile strike round and round until it dies.

name: Clear Bed
description: Scour the bed of the current until soul erosion and stray taint wash out of an ally.

name: Shallow Cross
description: Cross the contest at its shallowest point and arrive where the current is slow.

name: Surge Guard
description: Swell the current into a surge that stands between the user and a heavy soul assault.

name: Drowning Pull
description: Pull the force of a hostile blow down beneath the surface and drown its shape.

name: Great Current
description: Open the whole current to carry away every hostile force while it mends the user and allies alike.

name: Refusal Oath
description: Swear within the mind to refuse any intruding will and hold to the refusal.

name: Sworn Slip
description: Let the sworn refusal turn an intruding thought away before it can take root.

name: Intrusion Mark
description: Mark the place in the mind where an unseen will has touched and note its flavour.

name: Oath Renew
description: Renew the oath after a hard push and let the strain of the refusal fade.

name: Foreign Thought
description: Name a foreign thought planted in an ally and draw it out by its roots.

name: Oath Answer
description: Answer an intruding will with the same refusal turned outward.

name: Shuttered Mind
description: Close every opening of the mind at once so that no will can reach in.

name: Oath Clasp
description: Lock the refusal across the minds of nearby allies so that all stand closed together.

name: Sworn Refusal
description: Speak the full refusal and unmake the force of every intruding will within reach.

name: Even Mind
description: Hold the mind level and open as a plain so that a hostile force finds no cover.

name: Far Horizon
description: Look to the far edge of the plain and see any force that gathers there.

name: Open Slip
description: Step out of the path of a coming force while it is still far off.

name: Dusk Rest
description: Rest the mind in the long quiet of evening until the strain of the day leaves it.

name: Gather Sense
description: Sense a hostile will while it is still gathering and warn allies by a touch of thought.

name: Edge Walk
description: Walk the soul along the edge of the plain so that a pursuing force never closes.

name: Broad Hold
description: Spread the mind wide and thin so that a concentrated blow finds nothing to strike.

name: Level Stand
description: Stand on the open plain of the mind and let every attack die in the empty distance.

name: Distant Ward
description: Cast the ward out to the horizon so that it guards allies still far from the user.

name: Level Dominion
description: Make the whole plain of the mind a field where hostile force sinks and is read before it moves.

name: Calm Oath
description: Swear the oath of calm and let the whole soul settle upon it.

name: Oath Drift
description: Drift with a pushing will and let the oath keep the heart in place.

name: Gale Listen
description: Listen to the rising gale of will and tell its strength before it breaks.

name: Gust Gentling
description: Gentle a gust of hostile will until it brushes the soul like a breath.

name: Eye Hold
description: Hold the still eye at the centre of the storm and keep the mind there.

name: Calm Gift
description: Give an ally a measure of the sworn calm to still a shaking spirit.

name: Storm Passing
description: Let a storm of will pass over the mind and leave it whole and untouched.

name: Gustless Hush
description: Make a windless hush about the user and allies where hostile will cannot blow.

name: Unmoved Calm
description: Hold the sworn calm against a tempest of will until the tempest has no force left.

name: Keel Set
description: Fix a bearing in the soul and set the mind against it like a keel.

name: Pull Read
description: Read the direction and strength of a greater will that tugs at the bearing.

name: Keel Lean
description: Lean on the keel of the soul so that a hard push rolls past it.

name: Heading Mend
description: Bring the mind back to its heading after it has been wrenched aside.

name: Keel Heading
description: Hold the heading steady through a long pull that would break a lesser soul.

name: Stray Return
description: Return a mind led astray by a forced thought to its true line and clear the thought.

name: Counter Pull
description: Pull back with the sender's own strength along the bearing so that the pull fails.

name: Level Keel
description: Hold a steady course so exactly that every tug at the mind is cancelled.

name: Common Heading
description: Set one heading in the minds of allies so that they hold the same line against the pull.

name: Pole Star
description: Become the fixed point by which allies steer while every greater pull is swallowed.

name: Unbent Oath
description: Hold the oath so straight within the soul that no push can bend it.

name: Rising Stand
description: Rise from a stagger on the strength of the oath and turn the next blow aside.

name: Ruin Sense
description: Sense how much of the soul is still whole after a heavy blow has landed.

name: Soul Reknit
description: Gather the scattered pieces of a bruised soul back about the oath.

name: Fragment Cleanse
description: Cleanse the loose fragments of a splintered soul and set them back in order.

name: Iron Vow
description: Harden the oath into iron for a single heartbeat against a killing blow.

name: Through Ruin
description: Carry the soul unbroken through the fall of a great contest of wills.

name: Vow Revival
description: Call back an ally whose soul has just been stunned from the edge of dying by speaking the oath over them.

name: Unbowed Sovereign
description: Stand unbowed in the heart of a ruinous assault and fling its force back whole.
